description: Fixture modelled on the Federal Register documents API (tariff-related documents). Not live data.

results.title: Adjusting Imports of Copper and Derivative Copper Products Into the United States
results.abstract: Proclamation imposing a 50 percent ad valorem tariff under Section 232 of the Trade Expansion Act of 1962 on semi-finished copper and intensive copper derivative products, effective September 1, 2026.

results.title: Certain Hot-Rolled Steel Flat Products From the Republic of Korea: Final Results of Antidumping Duty Administrative Review; 2024-2025
results.abstract: Commerce determines that producers of hot-rolled steel from Korea sold subject merchandise in the United States at less than normal value during the period of review at weighted-average dumping margins of 3.12 to 7.45 percent.

results.title: Notice of Modification of Section 301 Action: China's Acts, Policies, and Practices Related to Technology Transfer—Exclusions Extension
results.abstract: USTR extends 164 product exclusions from Section 301 tariffs through May 31, 2027, and opens a docket for comments on further extensions.

agencies.name: Office of the United States Trade Representative

results.title: Implementation of Reciprocal Tariff Rate Modifications Under the International Emergency Economic Powers Act: Technical Amendments to the Harmonized Tariff Schedule
results.abstract: CBP provides guidance and HTSUS annex corrections implementing the modified country-specific reciprocal tariff rates announced in Executive Order 14355.

results.title: Crystalline Silicon Photovoltaic Cells From Cambodia, Malaysia, Thailand, and Vietnam: Countervailing Duty Orders
results.abstract: Commerce issues countervailing duty orders on solar cells and modules with subsidy rates ranging from 14.64 percent to 3,403.96 percent.

results.title: Addition of Entities to the Entity List; Revision of Entries on the Entity List
results.abstract: BIS adds 23 entities under the destinations of China, Iran, and the United Arab Emirates for activities contrary to U.S. national security, imposing a license requirement for all items subject to the EAR.

results.title: Elimination of De Minimis Duty-Free Treatment for Low-Value Shipments From All Countries: Implementation
results.abstract: Interim final rule amending 19 CFR part 10 to end administrative exemption for shipments valued at $800 or less and establishing a specific duty option of $80 to $200 per item for postal shipments.

results.title: Aluminum Extrusions From the People's Republic of China: Preliminary Results of Antidumping Duty Administrative Review
results.abstract: Commerce preliminarily determines that aluminum extrusions from China were sold at less than normal value; interested parties may comment within 30 days.

results.title: Continuation of Antidumping Duty Orders: Certain Passenger Vehicle and Light Truck Tires From Taiwan, Thailand, and Vietnam
results.abstract: As a result of the determinations by Commerce and the ITC that revocation would likely lead to continuation or recurrence of dumping and material injury, the orders are continued for five years.

results.title: Section 232 National Security Investigation of Imports of Polysilicon and Its Derivatives: Request for Public Comments
results.abstract: BIS initiates an investigation to determine the effects on national security of imports of polysilicon and derivative products and invites comments within 21 days.
